narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>The bottom number one hundred is the biggest, so three hundredths is the longest.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But three tenths is thirty hundredths, which is far more than three.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>More parts in the bottom number mean smaller parts, not a longer length.
